summary: Implemented a deterministic paper-only operator review table for crypto numeric scorer outputs. The report reads the scorer JSON, emits concise per-market review rows in JSON or Markdown, includes grouped decision counts, and preserves locked safety flags.
limitations: Consumes offline scorer output only; it does not fetch live markets or prices.
Provides operator review rows and grouped counts only; it does not size paper positions or create runtime actions.
No runtime/demo dispatcher wiring was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-003-CRYPTO-NUMERIC-REASON-CODES: add stable machine-readable reason codes for scorer and review-table outputs while preserving offline-only and no-runtime-wiring boundaries.
